change_reason: V2 recovered the coefficient and reduced RMSE 76.9 percent, but binary within-two-grid peak alignment saturated at 92.7 percent for the baseline; V3 uses continuous circular peak distance.
peak_metric: Mean circular grid distance from each true peak to the nearest predicted peak; lower is better.
falsification: Unchanged except replacing the saturated binary peak metric with continuous distance reduction.
scope_limit: Synthetic one-dimensional cortical strip only; not evidence that biological cortical folds encode a twisted latent space.
